description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'SnakesLaddersBoard' that renders a 10x10 game board with features like ladders, snakes, and player token placement, utilizing provider state management and custom styling.

classes.name: SnakesLaddersBoard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a 10x10 snakes and ladders board with visual indicators for snakes, ladders, and the player's position.

methods.name: _calcRow
methods.description: Calculates the row index for a given cell index on the board.

methods.name: _isReversedRow
methods.description: Determines whether a row should be reversed (used for zigzag numbering).

methods.name: _displayNumberForIndex
methods.description: Computes the display number for a cell based on its index, taking into account zigzag pattern.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the snakes and ladders board, rendering grid cells with appropriate markers.
